title: Another Word for Beautiful: 15 Synonyms With Pictures (Memory Challenge)
description:
Another word for beautiful? Here are 15 synonyms for beautiful, from cute to breathtaking, each with a picture and its meaning.
Memory challenge: ten words in a plain list, then one silly story. How many can you remember each time? Grab a pen: you get two scores.

1. Watch the list, then pause the video and write down every word you remember. That's your list score.
2. Watch the story, then pause again and write down every word you can recall, in order. That's your story score.
3. Stay for the surprise at the end, and the whole BEAUTIFUL ladder on one screen.
4. Comment your two scores: list versus story.

The story goes roughly from nice to look at to extremely beautiful: cute, pretty, picturesque, lovely, attractive, good-looking, handsome, elegant, graceful, exquisite, striking, radiant, gorgeous, stunning, breathtaking. For each word, you learn what it means and, for most of them, who or what it's used for: babies and small animals ("cute"), usually men ("handsome"), places and views ("a picturesque village", "a breathtaking view"), the way someone or something moves ("graceful"), small, delicate things made with great care ("exquisite jewellery"), and faces and smiles ("a radiant smile"). You also learn that "lovely" is very common in British English, and that "gorgeous" is a bit informal and very common when you speak.

Tonight, try it with your own new words: one silly story, one picture for each word.

For more words, look up "another word for beautiful" on anotherwordfor.net: https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-beautiful/
